headline: From "First Stock of New Tea Drinks" to "Penny Stock": Nayuki and Its Franchisees Are Still Waiting to Recover Their Investment
summary: Nayuki's share price fell to penny-stock levels in 2026 and its market value dropped sharply. Staff cuts reduced losses but sales have not improved.
why: Nayuki is a Chinese tea-drink chain whose listed equity and franchise network depend on consumer demand and brand strength in China.
